summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and, at install time, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing hex-name variables, a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW), a large numeric constant table, and a custom base64-style decoder over a scrambled alphabet. The content is deliberately unreadable and does not correspond to the package's advertised chatbot-UI client purpose. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install and using it to execute an obfuscated bundled script bypasses Node-based tooling and runs attacker-authored code on the installing machine as a lifecycle side effect of `npm install`. The package name and scope impersonate ServiceTitan's Titan chatbot client but the shipped install-time behavior is unrelated to any chatbot functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
